task_completion.description: At least 4 partition walls and 2 doors are added to create enclosed spaces (Walk-in Cooler and Workspace).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 2D plan or 3D view shows new internal wall segments forming distinct rooms with door icons/models placed within them.

task_completion.description: At least 3 rooms are defined with names (e.g., Retail Storefront, Walk-in Cooler, Workspace) and at least 2 have distinct floor colors/textures.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Text labels visible on the 2D floor plan naming the rooms; the 3D view shows different colors or patterns on the floor surfaces of at least two rooms.

task_completion.description: The workspace contains at least 2 sinks and 3 large desks or tables.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the designated workspace area, the VLM should identify 2 sink fixtures and 3 distinct table/desk models from the furniture list or 3D view.

task_completion.description: The retail area contains at least 5 display shelves, a checkout counter, and 3 chairs or sofas.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the storefront area, the VLM should count 5 shelving units, a specific counter/desk for checkout, and 3 seating items (chairs/sofas).

task_completion.description: The design includes at least 10 botanical items and a minimum of 35 total furniture items.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The furniture list pane (usually bottom left) shows a high volume of items; the 3D view shows numerous plants/flowers (botanical items) and a densely furnished shop.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to place items and draw walls.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the catalog, drawing tools, and the 2D/3D workspace rather than just terminal output.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply open a pre-made complete file but built the design.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the progression from an empty floor plan (starter file) to a furnished one.

integrity.description: Items are sourced from the built-in Sweet Home 3D furniture catalog.
integrity.visual_evidence: The furniture list names correspond to standard Sweet Home 3D categories (e.g., 'Kitchen', 'Living room', 'Miscellaneous').

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task starts with 'floral_shop_starter.sh3d', which is a shell of a building with no furniture. The agent must manually add walls, define rooms, and place at least 35 items total. A passing score requires at least 70/100 points. The VLM should specifically verify the 'Furniture list' pane in the GUI to confirm item counts if the 3D view is cluttered.
